review: 701.42b-1: only the token branch of 701.42b was exercised; added clone_partner, a card copying Midnight Scavengers that is not a meld card.

scenarios.title: Melding puts the two cards onto the battlefield combined as one permanent
decisions: A moves to the beginning of combat. Graf Rats' trigger fires; A has no other action and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: meld_pair
variants.expected: Graf Rats and Midnight Scavengers are exiled and A's Chittering Host (5/6, haste, menace) enters the battlefield. It is one permanent represented by both cards; neither Graf Rats nor Midnight Scavengers is on the battlefield as a separate permanent.

variants.label: wrong_partner
variants.delta: A controls Hill Giant instead of Midnight Scavengers.
variants.expected: Graf Rats' trigger does not fire. Graf Rats and Hill Giant stay on the battlefield and nothing is exiled.

scenarios.title: A token cannot be melded

setup.notes: The token is a copy of Midnight Scavengers, so it has the card's name.

decisions: A moves to the beginning of combat. Graf Rats' trigger fires (a creature named Midnight Scavengers is present); A has no other action and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: token_partner
variants.expected: Graf Rats and the Midnight Scavengers token are exiled. The token ceases to exist, Graf Rats stays in exile, and no Chittering Host enters the battlefield.

variants.label: token_primary
variants.delta: Graf Rats is the token (a copy of Graf Rats) and Midnight Scavengers is the card.
variants.expected: Both are exiled. The Graf Rats token ceases to exist, Midnight Scavengers stays in exile, and no Chittering Host enters the battlefield.

variants.label: clone_partner
variants.delta: The Midnight Scavengers is Clone, a card that entered as a copy of Midnight Scavengers, instead of a token.
variants.expected: Graf Rats and the Clone are exiled. The Clone is not a meld card, so nothing is melded: Graf Rats and Clone both stay in exile as cards, and no Chittering Host enters the battlefield.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.delta: Both Graf Rats and Midnight Scavengers are cards, not tokens.
variants.expected: Both are exiled and melded: Chittering Host (5/6, haste, menace) enters the battlefield as one permanent.

scenarios.forge_notes: The token-primary variant needs a token copy of Graf Rats carrying the card's trigger. The clone_partner variant needs Clone on the battlefield already copying Midnight Scavengers.

scenarios.title: Objects that cannot be melded stay in their current zone

setup.notes: The token is a copy of Hanweir Garrison.

decisions: A activates Hanweir Battlements' meld ability, tapping all five Mountains for the mana and tapping Hanweir Battlements.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: token_garrison
variants.expected: Hanweir Battlements and the token are exiled. The token ceases to exist, Hanweir Battlements stays in exile, and no Hanweir, the Writhing Township enters the battlefield.

variants.label: real_garrison
variants.delta: Hanweir Garrison is a card, not a token.
variants.expected: Both are exiled and melded: Hanweir, the Writhing Township (7/4, trample, haste) enters the battlefield as one permanent.

variants.label: garrison_absent
variants.delta: Hanweir Garrison is a card in A's graveyard instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The ability resolves but A controls no creature named Hanweir Garrison, so nothing is exiled. Hanweir Battlements stays on the battlefield, tapped.
